audioOutput.title: Virtual microphone audio
audioOutput.intro: In Discord, Zoom, or your game, choose CABLE Output as the microphone. Here in the app, the voice goes out through CABLE Input (below).
audioOutput.permission: To see device names I need a quick permission grant.
audioOutput.cableHint: The voice enters here. Choose CABLE Input (already marked as recommended).
audioOutput.monitorHint: The output for you to hear your own voice while it goes to Discord. Choose your headset/speaker — or leave it muted if you'd rather not hear yourself.
audioOutput.monitorMutedWarning: Monitor muted: Discord hears it, but you won't hear your own voice.

toast.sentCableHeard: Sent to the virtual microphone and your headset. In Discord, confirm CABLE Output as your microphone.
toast.sentCableMuted: Sent to the virtual microphone (monitor muted). In Discord, confirm CABLE Output as your microphone.
toast.playedHeadset: Played on your headset/speaker. Select the virtual microphone for Discord to hear it.
toast.nothing: Monitor muted and no virtual microphone: nothing to hear.
